facts.text: The repository is a collection of models for the MuJoCo physics engine from ROBOTIS
The models are designed for use with the MuJoCo physics engine
The card's main model is the MJCF scene robotis_ffw/scene_ffw_bg2.xml, whose root element is <mujoco model="ffw_bg2 scene">
The scene includes the robot model ffw_bg2.xml
The robot model's root element is <mujoco model="ffw_bg2">
The model compiles with angles in radians and automatic limits
The <option> element sets integrator implicitfast, cone elliptic and impratio 10, and sets no timestep
The robot's first body is arm_base_link and its first joint is lift_joint
The model has 19 position actuators: one lift slider, two head joints, seven joints per arm and one gripper actuator per hand
Every position actuator declares inheritrange="1" and names the joint it drives
The lift joint is a slide joint with range -0.5 to 0.0
The head joint ranges are -0.2317 to 0.6951 and -0.35 to 0.35
The gripper joint ranges are 0 to 1.1, -1.1 to 0 and 0 to 1.1
The gripper fingers are coupled to the first gripper joint by six equality constraints with polycoef 0 -1 0 0 0 or 0 1 0 0 0
The model references 23 STL mesh files with scale 0.001

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the scene and its include for the joint dimensions and per-actuator control ranges, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts, friction and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
no mesh or texture of the asset directory is loaded and no contact, equality, tendon or actuator constraint is resolved by the stand-in; the six gripper equality constraints are not applied
the model's <option> sets no timestep (robotis_ffw/ffw_bg2.xml:4); the stand-in uses a 2 ms placeholder, and MuJoCo's library default was not read or verified here
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine
only the card's models[0] scene is served; the other FFW scenes, OMX, OMY, OP3, OpenMANIPULATOR-X and TurtleBot3 models in the repository are not served by this package
no physical robot is modelled and nothing was validated against the FFW-BG2 hardware
